I could not add the comment because there is no caching function anywhere I can access.

What I checked:

- **This directory** holds only eval prompts, grader files, run logs, and run outputs. It has no source code at all, and git shows no tracked changes here.
- **Your request is verbatim the prompt** of the eval at `evals/n8n-concise-comment-cache/prompt.md`. That eval names no file or function either.
- **The eval config** points at an n8n instruction file under a scratchpad path outside this session's allowed directories, so I could not look there. Reading the root AGENTS.md was also denied.

To finish this, tell me the file path or function name of the caching function, or point me at the n8n checkout that contains it. Once I can see the code, I would write a short comment that explains why the cache exists and the one or two tradeoffs a reader actually needs, rather than an exhaustive list, since long design essays in code comments tend to go stale. If you want the full rationale documented, a design note or PR description is the better home for it, and I can draft both.
